_comment: Settings for the work queue. Installed as ko.config.json in the project root. Missing fields get the defaults in scripts/orkestrator/lib/koKonfig.js. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_gater: Shell commands the tracks run before delivery (gater.mjs --rask / --full). Empty lists = no gates.
_migrasjoner: Optional numbered migrations. mappe = null turns the whole migration flow off.
arkitekturRegler: Example rule: the UI layer never calls the database directly.
_moduler: Areas of the product for the plan register (ko.mjs plan moduler).

moduler.beskrivelse: Example module, rename or delete it
Projects that do not belong to a module yet

_kapasitet: Weekly quota reset used by ko.mjs kapasitet. null = default (Tuesday 19:00 Europe/Oslo). nullstillDag 0-6, 0 = Sunday.
